title: Inline sandbox snippets and 'Playground' for empty console canvases
creator: Mariana Kwan
description: Introduce an interactive 'Playground' experience embedded in empty dashboard and route canvases. The Playground combines executable snippets (sample requests, demo prompts, and embedding explorers), lightweight templates, and an immediate cost/latency preview to let new users achieve 'first success' without leaving the Console.
design_notes: Goal: reduce time-to-first-run for new signups and surface the cost implications of common workloads inline.
Core components: quick-start snippet card, mini-runner with mock tenant data, template carousel, inline cost estimator, tooltip-driven walkthrough steps.
Accessibility: keyboard-first runner controls, screen-reader labels for snippet execution output, color contrast verification for cost badges.
Fallbacks: sandbox runner uses mocked responses when backend capacity is unavailable; developer toggle to run against real API keys (opt-in).
Data retention: runner logs are ephemeral and clearly marked not to persist; link to privacy and audit docs in footer.
Design trade-offs considered: full-featured interactive tutorial vs compact inline snippets. We prioritize low cognitive load and rapid completion over comprehensive feature coverage in v1.
acceptance_criteria: Empty dashboard/views show a Playground card with a minimum of three curated snippets relevant to the route (generation, embeddings, reranking).
User can run a snippet and see a streamed response inside the card within 3s median on hosted demo backend in staging.
Cost preview displays estimated token and GPU-unit cost per-run for each snippet and updates if user modifies prompt length or batch size.
Onboarding funnel metrics captured: click-to-run conversion, time-to-first-success, and playground NPS prompt recorded to analytics dashboard.
Figma prototype linked and validated in a 3-person design review; handed off to FE with component spec and tokens.
Feature flag gate + rollout plan created: beta for 10% of new orgs, with A/B test to measure activation lift.
progress_updates: 2026-02-12: Initial concept sketch and problem statement reviewed with PM and Eng. Prioritized as P1 for onboarding OKR.
2026-02-20: Mid-fidelity prototype completed; core interaction flows (run, modify, cost-preview) clickable in Figma.
2026-02-24: Engineering feasibility sync — runtime team flagged need for a mocked staging runner endpoint and rate limits for sandbox runs.
2026-02-28: Accessibility pass done; keyboard flows updated. Preparing handoff package and component tokens.
2026-03-01: Design review: minor copy edits (clarify ephemeral logs), accepted for handoff. Assigned to FE sprint 2026-W09.
reviews: Lila Morales (PM) — +1. Supported. Emphasized measuring activation and cost literacy change.
Noah Rivera (Eng) — +1 with notes. Implementation will use /staging/sandbox-run with a 10-request/min quota. Needs clear error state designs for quota exceed.
Priya Singh (Design) — Minor copy nits. Requested additional microcopy variants for enterprise vs trial flows.
Security (pre-check) — Reviewed data-retention note; KMS not required for mocked runner. Ops to verify audit trail labeling.
